query: I'm evaluating a 69-year-old woman inpatient with PE. Among women aged 64–74 with PE, medication complexity (distinct meds in first 24 hours) was stratified into tertiles. For each tertile report admissions, med score ranges, LOS, mortality%, and 30-day readmission%.
final_sql: SELECT tertile, COUNT(*) AS admission_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tertiles WHERE min_meds <= med_count AND max_meds >= med_count) AS med_score_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tertiles WHERE min_pH <= pH AND max_pH >= pH) AS pH_score_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tertiles WHERE min_lactate <= lactate AND max_lactate >= lactate) AS lactate_score_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tertiles WHERE min_mortality <= mortality AND max_mortality >= mortality) AS mortality_score_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tertiles WHERE min_transfers <= recent_transfers AND max_transfers >= recent_transfers) AS recent_transfer_count FROM tertiles GROUP BY tertile;
